method.renders: lightcraft-cli render, 16-bit TIFF, full size; correction on = {optics: {lens_profile: true, profile_distortion: 100}}, off = lens_profile false
method.isolation: every rendered file is a copy with an empty XMP sidecar next to it (the sidecar wins over embedded XMP), verified with develop.get
method.geometry: SIFT on 3000 px greyscale (CLAHE), RANSAC similarity (threshold 1 % of width) then least squares; residuals in full-size pixels; core = points within 5x the median
method.pixel_diff: absolute difference of 16-bit renders, in 8-bit levels
method.tone: regions from the reference frame render: windows = any channel >= 99 % (opened 7 px), shadows = darkest 10 %, mids = 40-60th percentile; median log2 linear luminance
